nodes.label: HospitALL Frontend Public Favicon/Logo
nodes.description: Public-facing favicon/logo for the HospitALL React web app. Brand mark depicts a teal/blue shield containing a stack of medical folders/documents (with a gear icon and a heart-marked clipboard), overlaid with a prominent medical cross and a stethoscope curling around the right side. Color palette is a teal-to-deep-blue gradient (cyan/teal transitioning to navy) on a transparent background. Glyphs: shield (security/protection), medical cross (healthcare), folder stack (records management), heart on clipboard (patient care), stethoscope (clinical), gear (settings/management). Communicates secure hospital records management.
